name: reject-name-unicode-skew
description: Unicode version skew sentinel: U+0301 (combining class 230) followed by U+10EFD (combining class 220, assigned in Unicode 15.0.0). Tables at UNICODE_VERSION 15.0.0 reject the order as non-canonical NFC; tables from 14.0 or older treat U+10EFD as unassigned (class 0) and accept. A build with pre-15.0 tables accepts this name and fails the run.
